notes.title: v3.4 - The Mystery Box Update
notes.notes:

[h2]The Mystery Box:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the Mystery Box
[*] Added the first Wumbo Weapon: The Ray Gun

notes.title: v3.3 - Engine Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Engine Update[/h1]
Nasty Zombies has been updated from UE5.4 to UE5.5. This brings optimisation to the lighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/41d6293dddc66e39968cbd11d2b1542919abe20c.png[/img]
[h2]In other news...[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Prestige Mode[/b] is now unlocked once you have purchased all power-ups and your current maximum amount of equipable perks
[*] [b]New modifier:[/b] Zombie Cap - you can change how many zombies can be alive at one time from the default of 24, to between 1 and 120 (larger numbers will severely impact performance) (this is an extra modifier)
[*] Lights no longer fade at long distance thanks to UE5.5
[*] The Sten tilts in the opposite direction when reloading so you can see the magazine.
[*] Added head explosion particles for headshots
[*] Crosshair is now dynamic and scales based on the players FoV
[*] You can rebind the toggle UI button
[/list]

notes.title: v3.1.2 - Monk Customisation Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]Monk Customisation Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hue, brightness, height and width are randomised initially, this will only happen once.
[*]Player head rotation is now dynamic, so all players heads will correctly look at their target regardless of their size.
[*]Adjusted the limitations of height and width.
[*]Width is now % based as it scales up with the height.
[/list]

notes.title: v3.0.1 - Backrooms Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The red light timer now begins when the required number of zombies have been killed.
[*]Killing the required amount of zombies will cause the elevator to ding and its red button to light up.
[*]The elevator will occasionally ding once it is active.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.35.9 - Further Kinetic Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]Further Kinetic Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Guns now scale up to 25% increased damage through Kinetic Energy, up from 10%.
[*]Kinetic Energy can now be overcharged by 2.5 seconds.
[*]The Kinetic Energy bar is now in the middle of the screen, thinner, and is bevelled.
[*]The money counters in the bottom right corner have switched places, putting the take home money above the current money.
[*]You will no longer get stuck on pipes when jumping onto them.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.35.7 - Enraged & Kinetic Changes
notes.notes:
[h2][/h2]
[list]
[*]Enraged zombies can now have multiple targets and can switch targets.
[*]All weapons now use Kinetic Energy to empower them. Guns scale up to 10% increased damage when the Kinetic Energy Bar is filled.
[*]Max Ammo now fills your Kinetic Energy.
[*]Bottomless Clip now prevents Kinetic Energy from draining.
[*]The Zombie Spawn rooms in the basement now count as outside.
[*]Dead players can now repair barricades.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.35 - The Sledgehammer Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Sledgehammer Update[/h1]
This update introduces the Sledgehammer, a brutal new weapon built for pure destruction. While slow, it delivers massive damage with each swing and boasts high penetration, making it perfect for crushing hordes. Every hit lands with bone-shattering force, tearing through nasties in a gory, satisfying display of carnage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/4fbe8dff51e238dd1fe85d93f39f0550639b18be.png[/img]
[h2]In other news...[/h2]
[list]
[*]Non-starter melee weapons now use Kinetic Energy to increase their attack speed. You can build Kinetic Energy by moving.
[*]When Prestiging, you will now retain 10% of your money.
[*]Expanded the small zombie spawn room in the basement.
[*]The Spade's model and texture has been modified.
[*]Added more weapon spawn locations around the map.
[*]Added DPS stats to the weapons screen.
[*]Breaching zombies are now significantly more likely to spawn inside.
[*]Standing inside of a zombie spawn room will increase the chance of zombies spawning there.
[*]Added a Dynamic/Static Field of View toggle.
[*]If using Always Sprint mode, you can hold the sprint key to walk.
[*]The minimum FoV has been reduced to 60 and maximum increased to 120.
[*]Connected to two zombie spawn rooms at the back of the pipe and coffin rooms.
[*]New bullet firing VFX.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.34 - The Decayed Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Decayed Update[/h1]
This update shakes up gameplay with Decay, a brutal new zombie wave that forces you to rethink your strategy. We've also added a brand-new movement ability, Air Dash, giving you more mobility in combat. The Marathon perk is gone—stamina is no longer a concern, so you can sprint endlessly. A fresh perk, Kinetic Recovery, takes marathons place, it rewards movement with faster healing.

[h2]New Wave: Decayed[/h2]
The nasty just got even nastier. In "Decayed" waves, zombies will spawn decayed, with missing arms, and sometimes, even without a head, yet they’ll keep coming for you like nothing happened. They don’t need eyes to hunt you down, so stay sharp, switch up your strategies because these relentless husks won’t go down easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/08b88a6461e4f5e33c072f020ee8b9f2a52b4b01.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Movement Ability: Air Dash[/h2]
- You can now dash whilst in the air, this is bound to the jump key by default. Just hit the air dash button whilst in the air to dash.

[h2]REMOVED: Marathon[/h2]
- Marathon has been removed from the game, you no longer have stamina and can sprint forever.

[h2]NEW PERK: Kinetic Recovery[/h2]
- While moving, the time until you begin healing is reduced. (You must move around, you can't stand in the same place and move left to right).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/28fc970b64195e5448df8f83f09ddee37a8cd919.png[/img]
[h2]Vengeance[/h2]
- Vengeance now specifically rebounds taken damage back to the attacking zombie's head... if they have one that is...

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
- The Winchester now does less headshot damage and more body damage

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]
- It’s Just a Flesh Wound: Survive a wave of decayed Nasty Zombies.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/22e4219b65a323a6a7cfd68d5008e1ec7a2dc714.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/6337feba8c146ca24010a827d7faf897ed9d7205.png[/img][/url]
- No Brainer: Reach wave 50 with the "Permanent Decay" modifier active.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/81ea2a935fad30c5b328ff886e608822bd2101e7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/c7df2fe814b2266fa8ff2a6d6a8f4bc6daf61d0a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: v2.33 - The Katana Update
notes.notes:
[b][u]Weapons[/u][/b]
- Added Katana
- Melee weapons reworked – they no longer use crosshairs; the weapon itself must collide with the target
- All weapons have been rebalanced
- Akimbo weapons are generally far cheaper
- There is a new accuracy/range stat in the weapons screen
- Added more weapon purchase locations around the map  
- More detailed stats are visible on the weapon screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/0156cc45b2547ca8dc6ac8a2fc27b0acb7e8a82b.png[/img]
[b][u]Zombies & Balancing[/u][/b]  
- Breach zombies are 2× as likely to spawn inside  
- There are now less zombies per wave in multiplayer than previously
- Zombie legs are more tanky  
- Zombie health scales faster and to wave 50 instead of 100

[b][u]Barricades & Economy[/u][/b]  
- Barricades give more money per repair but only up to 10 times per barricade per round  
- Fortify no longer gives money for repairing barricades  
- You earn significantly more money in multiplayer, but "Take Home" money remains unchanged  
- Prices (except for weapons) scale up based on player count  

[b][u]Chronopulse Changes[/u][/b]  
- Chronopulse now slows to 1/4 speed again  
- Chronopulse no longer affects weapon switch speed  
- Chronopulse no longer affects melee weapon speed  
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/01f25681ed4f8026fb27d9ee6d9d108f1bb3e293.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/4f4f3b356fa1f8f082e6ef8fc1c30a601a48ef2b.png[/img][/url]

[b][u]Gameplay & UI[/u][/b]  
- F1 toggles UI on and off
- Fire mode selection: 1-button or 2-button, this allows you to individually fire your akimbo weapons
- Gunslinger will start reloading holstered weapon after 1 second
- Scavenged ammo scales up with wave number

[b][u]Achievements[/u][/b]  
- Chop Chop: Reach wave 50 using only melee weapons
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/14642c175a904d25e497cdbb6901e3c3acf26c61.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/2cc8108d942bfaf53339e1836bf57890f9e2387c.png[/img][/url]
- Nasty Zoombies: Reach wave 50 with the "Zoombies" modifier active
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/298f4d00dc689879ebf9c72d164808e24f5da1bc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/6ff3d2ab31ca3c70a7304bcfbba3706e8c27e141.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: v2.32 - The Scavenge and Camo Update
notes.notes:
[h2]WEAPON CAMOS[/h2]
Every weapon can now be ranked up by getting headshot kills, doing so will unlock camos for that weapon. There are 11 camos for each weapon to unlock. Along with this is a nifty new interface in the main menu where you can view all of your weapons and their stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/6e318c8a8bea7cc36ca1969da0eed8aad37edff8.png[/img]
[h2]NEW PERK - SCAVENGER[/h2]
Scavenger allows you to scavenge ammo from dead zombies. They will have a change to drop a small bag of ammo to help keep you topped up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/233f9b199c04d602a74a78c4d2ba47a724a952e8.png[/img]

[h2]BREN REBALANCE[/h2]
The Bren deals a little more damage, and its price has been doubled to £20.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/c8e486c24a9ac7f40dd13e30f1da45b355007eba.png[/img]

[h2]NEW WEAPON - SPADE[/h2]
This new melee weapon hits slightly harder than the baseball bat, but with a slower attack speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/fa50c092be751c096a245f935646e66cc67a9fe9.png[/img]
[h2]NEW WEAPON - THOMPSON[/h2]
This new gun sits between the Sten and Bren in terms of power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/ab4f936e6a0674205552fab5df02078bc85603c7.png[/img]
[h2]NEW SPECIAL WAVE - BREACH[/h2]
This new special wave type will allow zombies to spawn inside of the map!

[h2]In Other News...[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fragile Fortune has been removed, you can now set the base monk health in the Maps & Modifiers menu.
[*]Your monk in the main menu will now hold the last selected weapon from the weapon interface.
[*]Zombie Spawn points will become active if you approach them.
[*]Enraged Zombies minimum health and speed now match Wave 25 zombies.
[*]The "Machine" now has a 1-wave cooldown instead of 15 minutes, and its base price is £50, lowered from £100.
[*]Repairing Barricades now awards a small amount of money.
[*]Weapon spawns are more random.
[*]The bullet VFX has been changed.
[*]Chronopulse now slows to 50% speed instead of 25% as it just felt too slow.
[*]Multiple objects around the map have been visually overhauled.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.31 - The Modifiers Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Modifiers Update[/h1]
There are now two types of modifiers you can apply to the game: [b]Modifiers [/b]and [b]Extra Modifiers[/b].

[b]Modifiers[/b]: These let you play the game normally, though the game may be somewhat more difficult depending which modifiers you have active.

[b]Extra Modifiers[/b]: Since these can make the game easier, they disable stat tracking, leaderboards and achievements. However, you can still earn money, albeit at half the usual rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/0a02dd64c551849c5f23c5518857cc8f9b6ef4bf.png[/img]

[h2]Feel free to suggest more modifiers
in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/jEs7r52Xs7]Official Nasty Zombies Discord![/url][/h2]

notes.title: v2.30 - The Akimbo Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Akimbo Update[/h1]

[h2]Akimbo[/h2]
You can now equip 2 weapons at the same time by purchasing a second weapon; the second weapon costs 10x as much as the first weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/bfbe652dfefb1857c7fad7916ff4f933ee6ee934.png[/img]
[h2]NEW PERK: Bandolier[/h2]
This perk allows you to store more ammo and you get twice as much ammo per purchase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/9871bccfd7697a922cf668767b08370d7ae38f57.png[/img]

[h2]Weapons Rebalance[/h2]
Every weapon has been rebalanced to account for the potential doubled damage per second with akimbo weapons.
[list]
[*]Baseball Bat deals more damage.
[*]Ruction Baseball Bat deals more damage.
[*]Enfield No. 2 deals more damage but shoots slower.
[*]Bren deals more damage.
[*]Sten deals more damage.
[*]Lee Enfield deals more damage.
[*]Winchester deals less damage and now costs £50.
[*]M134 deals less damage and now costs £50.
[/list]
[h2]Zombie Rebalance[/h2]
Zombie health scales higher to match the new potential damage you have access to.

[h2]New Accessibility Setting[/h2]
You can now switch from Click-to-Fire to Hold-to-Fire, allowing you to hold to fire semi-automatic weapons. This functionality has been removed from Gunslinger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/6a038ca912c159f9c44887688c0bb8856ade9e5b.png[/img]

[h2]In other news...[/h2]
[list]
[*]You now start with maximum ammo in your ammo storage.
[*]Some ammo prices have been adjusted.
[*]Attempting to fire a gun that has no ammo now has a sound effect.[/list]

notes.title: v2.25 - UI & Customisation Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]UI & Customisation Changes[/h1]

[h2]UI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The ammo counter is now displayed to the left of the money counter.
[*]The remaining zombies text is now more readable.
[*]The game time is now more readable.
[*]The game time dynamically changes when Chronopulse is active.[/list]
[h2]Customisation Changes[/h2]
[list]

[/list]
[h2]In other news...[/h2]
[list]

[*]Zombies that die to attacking a fortified barricade now have a chance of dropping power-ups.[/list]

notes.title: v2.22.1 - Sprinting Changes
notes.notes:

[*]Stamina now takes 4 seconds to fully regenerate.

[*][b]Zoomies [/b]increases your movement speed by 10%, reduced from 25%.
[*]Zombies speed scaling has been adjusted based on these changes.
[/list]
[h2]In other news...[/h2]
[list]
[*]It is now impossible to get stuck inside of a barricade whilst building it.

[/list]

notes.title: v2.17 - The Touch Grass Update
notes.notes:

You can now go outside. Just run through a broken barricade, or just hop over the planks. Be careful out there, it gets awfully dark at night...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/4c938d31158b7b440dcb6f709113917b88495f8c.png[/img]

notes.title: v2.16 - The Mystery Update
notes.notes:
[h2]The Mystery Update[/h2]
have fun :)

notes.title: v2.8 - Zombie Pathing Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]Zombie Pathing Changes[/h2]
Zombies can now path back through the courtyard. There have also been some changes to their spawn locations.

[h2]Multiplayer Rebalance[/h2]
There are now less zombies per player in multiplayer, this will make getting to higher waves faster. There is now slight random variance in the amount of zombies per wave.

[h2]Wave 100 Speed Leaderboards[/h2]
There are now speedrunner leaderboards for every party size!

notes.title: v2.5 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Penetration Bug Fix[/h2]
When bullets penetrate multiple zombies, your damage will no longer go negative and heal the zombies.

[h2]Mutliplayer Game Crashing Fixed[/h2]
The host's game will no longer crash when returning the party to the lobby. This was caused by VOIP and has been removed.

notes.title: v2.0.2 - Discord & Multiplayer Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Discord & Multiplayer Changes[/h1]
I hope you’re all enjoying playing Nasty Zombies together! If you’re looking to jump into multiplayer but don’t have anyone to team up with, I’ve got great news—I’ve launched a Discord server where you can connect with others, make new friends, and form a party to take on the undead together.

[b][h2]Join Our Discord![/h2][/b]Our new Discord server is the perfect place to:
[list]
[*] Discuss all things Nasty Zombies
[*] Share your best screenshots and gameplay clips
[*] Stay up to date with the latest news and updates
[*] Find other people to team up and slay Nasty Zombies with![/list]You can also access the Discord directly through the new Socials tab added to the game’s main menu.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/jEs7r52Xs7]Click here to join the Discord![/url]

[b][h2]Rebalance[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Nasty Zombie's coin drops are now worth 10% more per player in the game.
Solo = 100% Value │ Duo = 110% Value │ Trio = 120% Value │ Quad = 130% Value
[*]Lee Enfield now deals 225 base damage, upped from 200.
[/list]
[b][h2]In Other News...[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Crawlers no longer have collision so you can't be body blocked by them.
[*]Chronomotion no longer takes effect between waves.
[*]You can no longer pick up power-ups if you're dead.
[*]The Zombie counter now uses a different font.
[*]Player walk animations are now more obvious and the footstep sound is synched with the animation.
[*]You can now interact with the Pause Menu if the "Start Next Wave" interface pops up.
[*]Changed some details on the discord status to include party size and prestige level.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1 - The Nasty Perks Update
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW PERKS[/h1][b][h3]Rapid Reload[/h3][/b]Reload you weapons incredibly fast. There'll be no more waiting around when you have to refill you guns.

[b][h3]Carpenter[/h3][/b]Repair barricades twice as fast, and place twice as many planks on entry points. You will be able to control sections of the map with ease.

[b][h3]Zoomies[/h3][/b]Get the Zoomies and move faster than any nasty zombie ever could. They'll never catch you at these speeds.

[b][h3]Ruction[/h3][/b]Melee weapons will always kill Nasty Zombies in one singular hit. This will help you fly through the early waves without spending a penny.

[h2]In other news...[/h2][list][*]Prices of Perks have been rebalanced, they start off more expensive but don't increase by as much with each purchase.
[*]4 brand new achievements to go along with the new perks.
[*]Added a burning barrel light source to the bottom of the stairs room as it was a bit too dark.
[*]Modified the main menu to have more Nasty Zombies.

[/list][h2]Upcoming[/h2]
Sorry about the lack of updates the past few months, I have been working on implementing multiplayer which has required a lot of self teaching as I've never worked with multiplayer before. I have made good progress so I'm really hoping I can get it out as soon as possible.
